# Third-party assets

Downloaded 2026-11-01. Large files are not in git: run `tools/fetch_assets.sh`,
which downloads each file and checks its pinned SHA-256. `cornell_box/`,
`mori_knob/` and `usc_campus/` are small and committed.

## OBJ/MTL models — McGuire Computer Graphics Archive (casual-effects.com/data)

| Folder | Model | Licence and credit | Download | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sports_car/` (fetched) | Sports Car | CC BY 4.0, © 2015 Yasutoshi Mori; converted to OBJ by Jamie Lesser | `sportsCar.zip`, 3,732,847 B | 300,603 triangles as parsed (10,157 tris + 145,223 quads); the archive page says 300,957. Replaces the Ferrari. |
| `mori_knob/` | Mori Knob (`testObj.obj`) | © Yasutoshi Mori; converted by Kenny Jones and Morgan McGuire. Archive page says CC BY 3.0; the bundled `copyright.txt` says CC BY 4.0 | `mori_knob.zip`, 244,361 B | 11,970 triangles; full scene (backdrop + orb); orb uses `illum 3` → environment reflection |
| `cornell_box/` | Cornell Box (8 variants) | CC BY 3.0, © 2009 Morgan McGuire; Guedis Cardenas, Morgan McGuire, Michael Mara; original by Cornell University | `CornellBox.zip`, 224,880 B | 36 triangles (Original); parser fixtures |

## glTF 2.0 — KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets (needs the glTF loader, U8)

| File (`gltf/`) | Licence and credit | Size |
|---|---|---|
| `SciFiHelmet/` (6 files) | CC0-1.0 — Michael Pavlovic; glTF conversion Norbert Nopper | 30,286,979 B |
| `Lantern.glb` | CC0-1.0 — sbtron; Draco compression Frank Galligan | 9,564,264 B |
| `NormalTangentMirrorTest.glb` | CC-BY-4.0 — Ed Mackey | 1,567,084 B |
| `DamagedHelmet.glb` | CC-BY-4.0 — ctxwing (rebuild and glTF conversion). **Caveat:** Khronos also lists the earlier version by theblueturtle_ as CC-BY-NC-4.0. Use for local testing only; keep out of anything commercial. | 3,773,916 B |

## HDR environments — Poly Haven (CC0, polyhaven.com/license)

| File (`hdri/`) | Size |
|---|---|
| `studio_small_08_2k.hdr` | 5,930,381 B |
| `venice_sunset_2k.hdr` | 5,723,224 B |

ImageIO loads `.hdr` with `--skybox`, but the engine stores textures as 8-bit, so
values above 1 clip until HDR textures and tone mapping arrive with U9.
